feature: Internal transfer orders with negative line quantities are auto-closed: an order whose lines all have qty <= 0 is marked finished (status done) by the allocation maintenance pass, negative lines no longer misread as "picked", and the PDA queue ignores all-negative orders
reason: Upstream ERP sometimes sends transfer orders with negative quantities (adjustment rows); they have no pickable demand and previously sat at pending/unallocated forever in the admin list
remarks: Implemented 2026-11-17 — spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-17-internal-transfer-negative-qty-autoclose-design.md. Backend `src/db/internalTransferAllocate.ts` refreshTransferAllocationStatus auto-close (status -> finished + transaction_logs row reason no_positive_qty, system actor) + recomputeTransferItem picked-guard (qty > 0); `src/db/internalTransferPicking.ts` listInternalTransferQueue positive-line filter. Header-only orders untouched (sync may add lines later); mixed orders keep positive lines working. Tests: `src/db/internalTransferAllocate.test.ts` auto-close block.
